official_gis.provider: Purdue University campus GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer, BuildingShapesZip4 layer 0
official_gis.feature_name: Drew & Brittany Brees Student Athletic Center
official_gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; original Purdue service uses EPSG:3857/102100 (as identified in prior project source docs)
official_gis.measurement_method: Official GIS ring transformed by project local geographic linear approximation, duplicate/collinear vertices simplified with iterative maximum local point-to-segment deviation tolerance 0.25m; horizontal origin is the original footprint bbox center.
official_gis.transform: X=(longitude - -86.9137) * 84810.6041653993 m/degree; Y=(latitude - 40.4274) * 111040.0 m/degree; Z up in meters; this is approximate project frame, not a surveyed CRS
official_gis.uncertainty: GIS service gives no survey tolerance/date; vertex accuracy and wall-to-outline association unverified; overhangs not represented.

architectural_references.published_facts: Purdue Athletics identifies the center as academic support for student-athletes and documents 2012 and 2019 renovations. Purdue GIS FID 255 reports two levels and 33 in its legacy extrusion field; that field has no documented unit/datum here, so height remains estimated. Purdue identifies the attached Holloway Gymnasium and the 2018 Board of Trustees plan shows group study rooms, tutoring, an open study/Vanguard hall, mentor lockers, and dividable classrooms. The official event photo supports red brick, dark horizontal upper cladding, climbing ivy, an athlete banner and gold facade lettering. Plan-derived room locations and the gym layout are schematic because the PDF is not georegistered to the GIS footprint.
architectural_references.google_maps_streetview: Not directly inspected in this subtask; image sources used where cited; model detail claims limited accordingly.

gold facade lettering and a packed original illustrated athlete banner graphic with champions/scholars/citizens lettering; custom graphic is inspired by the official Purdue exterior photo and contains no copied athlete photograph

modeled_interpretation.interior: Plan-derived but not georegistered schematic zones: tutoring, group-study rooms, an open Vanguard/study hall, classrooms, mentor/locker area, and an attached Holloway gym court with volleyball lines and bleachers. The gym/academic split is assigned by reading the unreferenced PDF diagram east/west and is uncertain; room placement, partitions, furniture, court scale, and bleachers are not surveyed.
modeled_interpretation.geometry_method: The 26-vertex FID 255 outline is preserved as the structural shell in the local coordinate frame. A two-floor brick envelope, narrow wall glazing, photo-supported dark upper cladding, ivy/banner/sign bay, and a plan-led north entry are modeled. Attached Holloway gym interior is included schematically without an unsupported external rooftop tower. Height and architectural subdivisions remain estimated.

validation.reopen_check: Separate Blender 5.2.3 LTS process opened the saved asset, verified FID 255, stable export collection, exact expected campus origin, object/material inventory, procedural material node trees, and no external image paths; it rerendered the saved scene.
